title: Umami Turkish Eggs Menemen
description: A savory Turkish dish featuring ground nutmeg and infused oil, perfect for a midnight craving. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe is a hearty and umami-rich breakfast option.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a fork until the whites and yolks are fully incorporated.
Heat the infused oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the diced tomato to the skillet and cook until it is tender.
Add the ground nutmeg, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour the whisked eggs over the tomato mixture in the skillet.
Cook the eggs over medium heat, stirring constantly, until they are set to your desired doneness.
Use a spatula to gently fold the eggs over on themselves, creating a shaggy texture.
Serve the Umami Turkish Eggs Menemen hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
